scope: Native installer payload identity, not compilation/source equivalence, signing validity, musical acceptance or DAW qualification
capture_stage: Freeze the actual existing build inputs after any intentional signing/stripping and before package creation
requirements: Exact expected component/file inventory with independent SHA-256 and byte count comparison
Regular-file and internal relative-symlink types/targets must be preserved; unsafe external links and special files rejected
POSIX permission bits are compared on Linux/macOS; Windows NTFS ACLs are explicitly not qualified
Debian Standalone mode normalization to0755 is an explicit registered transformation, not a blanket mode waiver
macOS PackageInfo identifiers and installation destinations must match the three declared binary components
Windows only qualifies the actually installed Standalone, never the uninstalled VST3 component
No silent expected-hash replacement when a package changes input bytes; signing/stripping must precede capture
Missing, extra, stale, byte-mutated, wrongly installed and mode-changed payloads fail closed
Actual guard-source mutants must fail intended ordinary assertions with zero runtime errors and retained positive controls
Expected primary executable must exist as a nonempty regular file; resources alone cannot certify a component
Artifact and expanded roots cannot be symlink/junction aliases; internal relative resource links are preserved exactly
Malformed native PackageInfo is an explicit ValueError, not an unclassified parser crash
test_platform_limits: Complete synthetic POSIX/link suite runs with zero skips on Linux/macOS. Windows explicitly skips POSIX permission/link fixtures and runs Standalone byte/scope tests plus native controller checks; no NTFS ACL or POSIX-on-Windows claim.
